scope: Supply, fabricate, shop prime, deliver and erect the structural steelwork scheduled below, to RP Designs drawings 3225-S01 to S03 and 2417-S04 to S08 (DRAFT).
Picture-frame moment frame (encased ground beam, cranked top beam, two columns) with Connection detail A and the 21-degree end plate as drawn on 2417-S06.
Loft beams S1/S2, first-floor beam F1, ridge beam R1, post C3 and ground-floor lintels L2/L3, with the plates, stiffeners and bolts listed.
Erection into openings, recesses and onto padstones prepared by others.

provisional.item: Connection design calculations and shop drawings for Engineer approval (S08 note 6)
30-minute fire protection to exposed steel (S08) - intumescent, if required in our scope

exclusions: Padstones, concrete encasement to the ground beam, foundations and all concrete work.
Builder's work: recesses, needling, temporary propping and works (S08 note 5), dry packing and making good.
Timber, joist hangers and restraint straps (30x5 / 30x2.5 straps per S08 and S03/S04 notes).
Fire protection unless instructed against the provisional sum above.
Party Wall Act matters, Building Control and Engineer's fees.
rfis: L2 and L3: section size not stated (L3 drawn blue on S01 but as concrete on S07). Priced as 152x152x23 UC placeholders.
FB1 crank: location, direction and rise of the 21-degree crank; C1 height depends on it (priced worst case 3.05 m).
Detail A plate: 300x210x25 (label) or 300x260x25 (stated 15 kg); bolt setting 125 or 180.
F1 east end: proposed fin plate onto L2 (instead of the padstone over the L2 bearing) - confirm, and size L2 for the F1 reaction.
S1/S2 north bearings (~211 mm) on the party wall - confirm.
Column resin anchors: 300 c/c each side of web (priced, 32 no.) or alternating (16 no.).
F1-to-FB1, F1-to-L2 and C3 cap/base connections are not detailed - designed by our standard connection rules, subject to connection design (S08 note 6).
R1 timber plate: one side or both (12 or 24 M12 bolts).
offer.programme: Shop drawings within 5 working days of order; fabrication 2-3 weeks after Engineer approval (5 working days review per S08 note 6); erection approx. 2 days.
offer.terms: Payment terms by agreement. Quantities are measured from the drawings issued; drawings state 'do not scale', so lengths are confirmed on site/approved shop drawings before fabrication and the price adjusted for any change.

connections.comment: Engineer-detailed joints only (2417-S05/S06). Everything else - F1 to FB1/L2, C3 to S2/R1 - is designed by the connection rules (takeoff/connections.py). Positions [x, y, z_mm] as grid refs / mm. Which top corner is Detail A vs the 21-deg end plate is inferred from the S02 'Cranked' leader (nearer C1) - confirm.
